items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: Mike Dubaniewicz and I were on the road with Maynard for years.

ctx.x: Has he learned the word “gig” yet?

Oh yeah. He knows when dad’s putting on his gig shoes. My father was a minister so it was church shoes. But for me it’s gig shoes. Yeah. But yeah so there’s a language there. Now when you have deeper relationships, you know, you can have more intimate, meaningful conversations. Of course I think the relationships are invaluable, when you talk about bands and regular relationships between people. Time counts for a lot you know. So I can have a great conversation with you but it’s not the same conversation that I…
Yeah. And sometimes when there’s a potential train wreck in the music it recovers nicely and it becomes like a thing.
